mission: Give every project in the factory a durable, isolated intelligence layer and feed it into every agent handoff, without changing the workflow engine.

successMetrics.name: Deterministic sensors live on a schedule

currentPriorities.title: Land Phase 1: project context layer + decision classifier
currentPriorities.rationale: Everything else builds on the context pack and the machine protocol.

currentPriorities.title: Keep the workflow engine untouched
currentPriorities.rationale: Regressions in the proven state machine are expensive and hard to spot.

risks.title: Context pack bloats handoffs or leaks between projects
risks.mitigation: Per-section char budgets, single-key registry resolution, redaction guard, determinism tests.

risks.title: State-dir key (repo basename) vs registry key mismatch bites the sensors
risks.mitigation: Reconcile before Phase 3; documented in context/MEMORY.md.

risks.title: A secret lands in a context file
risks.mitigation: redact.mjs refuses secret filenames and scrubs value patterns; emits a warning finding on any hit.
